uncertainties.note: 'Shinaseru mon ka' has no object. Rendered 'I won't let you die' on the reading that Tiffa is in the cockpit (1293-1294, 1313-1317). If the line is meant generally, 'No one is dying here!' would be safer. 'And' added only as a rhythm link between the three-part shout; reviewer may drop it.

Source says 'chijou' (the surface / the land) here but 'chikyuu' (Earth) in 1363; rendered 'the surface' vs 'the Earth' to keep the distinction. Speaker is an enemy commander (mentions Berkt's report in 1351), identity not written in.
'Tawai mo nai' - contemptuous 'that was nothing'; rendered 'Too easy.' Speaker presumably the Frost brother who attacked the Freeden (1398), untagged.

Could be the enemy pilot appraising the player's machine or a player-side pilot appraising the Ashtaron. 1370 continues with the enemy pilot talking about 'this machine' from the report, so probably the former; English keeps it open.

'Yatsu no houkoku' = that person's report. Rendered 'His report' because 1351 names Berkt's report and the glossary lists Berkt as male. If the reviewer thinks the referent is not settled, use 'The report says...'.
Literally 'killing them all is fine / I don't mind'. Rendered 'Kill them all, for all I care.' Speaker is the New Federation commander in the opening cutscene; untagged.

Source is a terse negative ('jama shinai!') following 'Move, move, move!' - read as a second pilot telling others not to get in the way (Witz then Roybea arriving). It could conceivably be a self-directed 'we won't get in the way'; imperative chosen.

Identical verb '...kimasu'. 1386 is completed by 'companions who will build the future together', so 'They're coming'. 1394 comes after the Satellite System activation (1392-1393), where in the source anime Tiffa announces the incoming microwave beam; rendered 'It's coming!'. If the cutscene shows the Londo Bell arrival instead, it should be 'They're coming!'.
Verb omitted ('to you, power...'); kept as a fragment rather than supplying 'I give'.
Source: 'Damn, me, by the likes of these...!' with the verb (being beaten) omitted. 'losing to' supplied as the minimal completion; 'the likes of them' keeps the contempt.

Post-mission window rows (no <ab>): source used manual line breaks over three lines; English is one string for the builder to wrap. All are within 110 visible characters but are the longest rows of the slice - check wrapping in-game.
Speaker addresses 'Captain' and is answered with 'Faye, ...' in 1426, so this is Faye speaking to Ruri. 1425's subject is omitted in the source but 1424 has an explicit 'we', so 'we' is carried over.
'Sono shounen' = 'that boy' (Garrod, present in the room). Passive in source ('Tiffa was taken away by that boy'); made active for length.
